titles.palette: Palette · warm paper and iridescent light
titles.type: Type · Bricolage Grotesque, Instrument Serif and DM Sans

logoDescription: A map pin holding a check, on a tile of iridescent light. In the wordmark, “near” carries the color.
paletteDescription: Warm paper and ink keep the page calm. Ember orange is for action, violet marks the one vivid word, and the iridescent light runs from ember to periwinkle. Each category has its own color on the map.
typeDescription: Bricolage Grotesque gives headlines a confident, friendly shape. Instrument Serif italic marks the one vivid word. DM Sans keeps the details clear.
body: Post what you need, agree on a price up front, and book a verified local helper.
small: Areas are approximate. A helper sees the exact address only after you book.
caption: Everyday help from people nearby, across the US.
motionDescription: Calm and quick. Text rises out of a mask line by line, cards bloom out of what you pressed, and sections arrive as you reach them. Only transform and opacity move, and with reduced motion everything shows in its final place.
